-    join_nn(enum_decls(enums), fn_decls(funcs))
+  # `Rian.Lower.rust_program` emits structs, then enums, then functions.
+  pub def compile_prog(structs Vec(StructDef), enums Vec(EnumDef), funcs Vec(Func)) String :=
+    join_nn(join_nn(struct_decls(structs), enum_decls(enums)), fn_decls(funcs))
+
+  # ── struct decl ──
+  def struct_decls(Vec(StructDef)) String
+  def struct_decls([]) := ""
+  def struct_decls([s]) := struct_decl(s)
+  def struct_decls([s | rest]) := struct_decl(s) <> "\n\n" <> struct_decls(rest)
+
+  def struct_decl(StructDef) String
+  def struct_decl(StructDef(name, fields)) :=
+    "#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\nstruct " <> name <> " { " <> param_decls(fields) <> " }"

@@ -235,6 +256,20 @@ mod SelfhostRust do
   pub def emit(CVariant(enum, ctor, named, pairs)) := variant_em(enum, ctor, named, pairs)
   pub def emit(CIf(c, th, el)) :=
     Em(s: "if " <> args0(c) <> " { " <> args0(th) <> " } else { " <> args0(el) <> " }", pr: 0)
+  # struct construction `Name { l: v, … }` (no `Enum::` prefix — a record, not a variant)
+  pub def emit(CStruct(name, pairs)) := Em(s: name <> " { " <> named_vals(pairs) <> " }", pr: 12)
+  # field access `p.x` (postfix, prec 12)
+  pub def emit(CDot(h, f)) := Em(s: paren(emit(h), 12) <> "." <> f, pr: 12)
+  # closed list `vec![…]`; cons `[e1, … | tail]` prepends onto an owned copy of the
+  # tail (`{ let mut __v = tail.to_vec(); __v.insert(0, en); … __v }`, ADR-0047)
+  pub def emit(CList(es, LClose)) := Em(s: "vec![" <> args_str(es) <> "]", pr: 12)
+  pub def emit(CList(es, LCons(t))) :=
+    Em(s: "{ let mut __v = " <> paren(emit(t), 12) <> ".to_vec(); " <> inserts(es) <> "__v }", pr: 0)
+
+  # one `__v.insert(0, e);` per element, in reverse so the result order is e1, …, en, tail…
+  def inserts(Vec(Core)) String
+  def inserts([]) := ""
+  def inserts([e | rest]) := inserts(rest) <> "__v.insert(0, " <> args0(e) <> "); "

+
+    test "a struct emits a derive'd record, named construction, and field access", %{mod: mod} do
+      out =

+      cons = ported(mod, "def pre(x Int64, xs iso Vec(Int64)) Vec(Int64) := [x | xs]")
